description: The chart illustrates the number of hateful communication datasets published per year, separated into “Untargeted” and “Targeted” categories using stacked bars. The horizontal axis lists years from 2012 through 2022 in chronological order and is labeled “Year.” The vertical axis is labeled “Number of datasets,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0 up to about 160 with regularly spaced tick marks at 20-unit intervals. Each year is represented by a stacked bar with a blue lower segment for “Untargeted” and an orange upper segment for “Targeted,” as indicated by the legend titled “Targets” in the upper-left. Approximate totals by year are: 2012 ~2 (orange only), 2013 ~2 (blue only), 2014 ~2 (orange only), 2015 ~2 (orange only), 2016 ~12 (blue ~4 plus orange ~8), 2017 ~28 (blue ~12 plus orange ~16), 2018 ~48 (blue ~20 plus orange ~28), 2019 ~65 (blue ~12 plus orange ~53), 2020 ~130 (blue ~48 plus orange ~82), 2021 ~160 (blue ~67 plus orange ~93), and 2022 ~37 (blue ~10 plus orange ~27). The bars are not sorted by magnitude but follow the year sequence, and no individual bars appear specially emphasized beyond the consistent color coding and stacking.
